stanza: Ah we're lonely, we're romantic
And the cider's laced with acid
And the Holy Spirit's crying, "Where's the beef?"
And the moon is swimming naked
And the summer night is fragrant
With a mighty expectation of relief
So we struggle and we stagger
Down the snakes and up the ladder
To the tower where the blessed hours chime
And I swear it happened just like this:
A sigh, a cry, a hungry kiss
The Gates of Love they budged an inch
I can't say much has happened since
But closing time

stanza: All my life I can remember longing
Looking across the water and seeing lights
When I was five or six we were camping in the islands in July, the tall yellow…
And then when I was twenty-four I followed this ache to an arctic Norwegian cab…
Her skin so bare
The fragrant air
Her vacant eye

fragrant.linePrev: Then there was music and wonderful roses
fragrant.line: They tell me in sweet fragrant meadows
stanza: Then there was music and wonderful roses
They tell me in sweet fragrant meadows
Of dawn and dew
